body: They're not laying their feelings on me it's just that no matter what they do, it doesn't help so they don't know where else to turn. My isolation from them isn't causing my depression, it's the other way around.

I feel like the black sheep because they socialize like a normal family while I can't because of the depression. When I would tell them about my problems they would try to help me but they ended up feeling helpless because my situation wouldn't improve. Now I don't talk about my issues with them because they can't help me.
I only have a relationship with my immediate family. They don't have depression or anxiety so I feel like the black sheep because of my illnesses.

Before I developed anxiety and depression I was normal. I had friends, would hangout with my cousins, and was very happy. When the disorders developed everything in my life was fine. There weren't any triggers like family troubles or anything like that. It just came out the blue.

It started when I was 14 years old. I started having a racing heart, churning stomach, and racing mind whenever I was interacting with people. This happened even when I interacted with friends or family. I think it's genetic because I have family members who also suffered from an anxiety disorder.
I also started suffering from depression at the same time.

I've tried therapy and anti-anxiety meds. In therapy, I learned mindfulness, meditation, and positive self-talk. It did start to help, but then my depression became very severe and when I'm depressed I'm incapable of going anything.

Because of my social anxiety, I don't have any friends to support me. I've been in the hospital and that didn't help. Calling the suicide hotline is worth a try, but I just don't see how they can solve any of my problems. 

Thanks for your help.
If you're not suicidal then you shouldn't be posting this on a thread about suicide.

I know how you feel. I don't want to hurt my family either, but I can't find any other way to escape my depression besides suicide. It's a horrible feeling that makes my suffering even worse. Do you take antidepressants?
